authority: Primary explicitly froze this baseline-only selection before any A6 final scores, 2026-11-14. Supplements goal-evaluation-freeze.json without replacing historical gates.
selection: Higher goal completion fraction; tie: fewer mean external model turns on each baseline's own completed tasks; exact tie: deterministic_packet. No optional model result enters selection.
primary_turn_gate: At least 10 percent mean external turn reduction on optional-model AND selected-baseline common-success questions only. Empty common-success set cannot pass.
reporting: Report both paired baseline comparisons, all-task failures and turns, categories, disagreements, and descriptive source-cluster intervals. The other baseline's turn comparison does not introduce a new acceptance gate.
unchanged: Each optional completion at least .75 and no more than .02 below strongest baseline, full original support/citation gates and all source/resource/budget requirements. No final scores consumed by this clarification.
